name: XlDataLabelsType
description: Specifies the type of data label to apply.

constants.name: xlDataLabelsShowValue
constants.description: Default value for the point (assumed if this argument is not specified).

constants.name: xlDataLabelsShowPercent
constants.description: Percentage of the total. Available only for pie charts and doughnut charts.

constants.name: xlDataLabelsShowLabelAndPercent
constants.description: Percentage of the total, and category for the point. Available only for pie charts and doughnut charts.

constants.name: xlDataLabelsShowBubbleSizes
constants.description: Show the size of the bubble in reference to the absolute value.
